title: A closed form for tau fits the rerun hmmbuild data
body:
Fit tau = a*ln(L) + b on the rerun TSVs, with new code, and check the fit before nail takes it.

## Proposal

- Least squares on training at seed 42, then the same two-decimal grid search on mean absolute error as the original. Both fits should land on 1.34 and -2.33 if the rerun data matches.
- Mean error, mean absolute error and standard deviation of the residuals on all three sets, for the fit and for nail's current form.
- Residuals against L in bins, to see whether ln(L) alone leaves a trend at short or long lengths.
- The four panels of the original figure, redrawn.

## Open

- Whether least squares and least absolute error give fits far enough apart to matter.
close_reason: New scripts in `tmp-claude/2026-10-14-tau-calibration/run`, run on the rerun TSVs, give the original result to every printed digit. Least squares gives a = 1.3423, b = -2.3495. The two-decimal grid on mean absolute error gives a = 1.34, b = -2.33. The redrawn four panels match the original figure on r, mean absolute error and standard deviation. The two criteria differ by 0.006 in mean error, which does not matter. Against single hmmbuild runs the fit has a residual standard deviation of 0.233. Two seeds of the same sequence differ with a standard deviation of 0.265, which puts the per-run seed noise near 0.19. So the error of the fit against the seed-averaged tau is near 0.13, the part that depends on the sequence and not its length. By length the residuals stay within 0.04 from 100 to 2,000 residues. They rise to +0.105 from 2,000 to 5,000 (2,328 sequences) and +0.190 above 5,000 (101). A quadratic in ln(L) moves the long bins to about +0.04, but it moves lengths under 100 to -0.071 and lowers the mean absolute error only from 0.1848 to 0.1846. The linear form stays. PANTHER has 2,877 training sequences under 100 residues. On the 49-sequence SwissProt bag in nail-7cf0cd, averaged over 100 seeds, the fit is off by -0.176 on average under 100 residues, with a range of -0.52 to +0.28 over 9 sequences. Too few sequences to act on. Result for nail: fwd_tau = mu = -(1.34*ln(L) - 2.33).
